## 🔍 개요
+ close #393 

## ✔️ 문제 풀이 진행 사항
올완

## 📝 문제 풀이 전략 및 실제 풀이 방법
- [백준_2146_다리 만들기]
A형 준비할 때 풀었던 기억이..ㅎ
BFS 이용해서 배열에 섬 번호 부여하고, 또 BFS 이용하여 현재 섬과 다른 번호의 섬을 만나는 경우 최솟값을 갱신해주었음!
저는 두 BFS 과정에서 같은 방문 배열을 이용하면서 중간에 초기화를 안해줘서 메모리 초과가 났었습니다.

- [백준_1327_소트 게임]
String 형태의 수열과 뒤집은 횟수를 가지고 BFS를 이용하여 풀었음. 수열을 String으로 변경하여 앞에서부터 k개씩 뒤집어서 새로운 수열을 구해서 큐에 넣어주면서 모든 경우를 탐색함. 
String의 subString을 이용하여 (숫자)+ (뒤집은 숫자)+(숫자) 이런 식으로 합쳐서 새로운 수열을 만들었음. 
초반에 저장해둔 입력 받은 수열의 오름차순과 비교하여 같다면 몇 번째 변경인지 반환하였음. 
이미 만들어졌던 수열인지 확인하기 위해 boolean[] 배열의 인덱스를 수열의 숫자로 가정하고 체크하였음. n의 최댓값이 8이므로 99,999,999 크기로 생성함.

- [백준_2665_미로만들기]
n,m에 도달하기 위해 최소한 교환 해야 하는 방 수를 저장하는 disf[][]배열을 두고 이 배열을 갱신해나갔음.
BFS로 진행하며 다음 칸이 검은 방인 경우에는 방을 바꿔야하므로 dist의 현재 위치 값에 +1을 해주고, 다음 칸이 흰 방이라면 그대로 값을 유지함. 
그 값과 다음 칸의 dist 값을 비교하여 다음 칸이 더 크다면, 더 적은 교환 횟수로 갈 수 있다는 것이므로 값을 치환해줌!
최종적으로 dist[n-1][n-1]칸에 최소 교환 횟수가 저장됨.

## ETC
char[]를 String으로 변경할 때 String.valueOf 는 char 배열 내용 기반으로 String 객체 자체를 새로 만들고,
toString()은 배열 객체의 메모리 위치인 해시 코드 값을 문자열로 반환해준다고 합니다.
String 형태로 배열 내용을 이용해야 할 때는 String.valueOf를 쓰는 것이 조을 듯 합니다..

commits.message: GH ACTION Headlines Wed Jan  1 15:00:03 UTC 2025

Remove the `getSelectedEditors` integration test helper function

The `getSelectedEditors` function is largely a copy of the `getEditors`
function, with three small differences:

1. `getEditors` allows getting any kind of editor whereas
   `getSelectedEditors` is harcoded to only getting selected editors.
2. `getEditors` returns editor selectors (strings) whereas
   `getSelectedEditors` returns editor IDs (integers).
3. `getSelectedEditors` returns a sorted array of editor IDs whereas
   `getEditors` does not ensure that the array is sorted.

This commit makes the `getEditors` function a drop-in replacement for
the `getSelectedEditors` function to deduplicate the code and to have a
unified way of getting editors.

Note that we don't actually use the contents of the returned array
(only its length), so we can safely change `getEditors` to return a
sorted array of integer editor IDs instead. Sorting the array makes the
return value deterministic, which is a nice property for test stability,
and integer IDs are also easier to handle in test assertions. Note that
the corresponding selector strings can also easily be obtained from the
integer IDs using the `getEditorSelector` function if needed.

pull_request.title: Fix and streamline capability handling
pull_request.body:
Fixes #46.

## What Changed

1. Fixes code preventing us from overwriting capbalities when they're already set by php-webdriver.
2. Streamlines the flow so that it is clearer how it behaves:
    1. start with the browser-specific capabilities provided by php-webdriver
    2. add mink default capabilities
    3. add mink browser-specific default capabilities
    4. add capabilities defined by the end user
3. 'add', in this case, always overwrites existing capabilities

## Remaining Questions

- How do we test this? (should we even test it?) In principle this is private behaviour and not something accessible from the outside.
- Should we be worried that this is a BC break? Existing users that have broken config would break their system, when in the past that config was unintentionally ignored.

issue.title: Support default exports of `iso` field declarations

labels.name: good first issue
labels.description: Good for newcomers

issue.body:
## Problem

* We use this regex to match named exports of iso field declarations:

```
    static ref EXTRACT_ISO_LITERAL: Regex =
        Regex::new(r"(export const ([^ ]+) =\s+)?iso(\()?`([^`]+)`(\))?(\()?").unwrap();
```
* This does not support default exports of iso literals

## Solution

* We should modify this regex to also support default exports of iso literals, and modify lines like `import { PetSummaryCard as resolver } from '../../../PetSummaryCard.tsx';` to be `import resolver from '../../../PetSummaryCard.tsx';` in cases where the user uses a default export
* We should also add some unit tests here!

issue.title: XAFS/pre_edge.py _finde0 recieves numpy arrays and pandas series
issue.body:
Hi,

Thanks for curating such a great set of tools. I've been using the XAFS package, and running into an error with the find_e0 function, which redirects to the _finde0 function, and hits the error on line 80 of pre_edge.py, which is "mu = mu_input[ordered]". It seems that I was accidentally passing pandas data series, and the find_e0 function was only converting these to numpy arrays some of the time. The function accepts either a numpy array (seemingly the intended data type) or a pandas series, which causes a particularly undescriptive error. I've found that importing pandas into pre_edge.py and adding an if statement to check for pandas series and convert to numpy array fixes the error. The if statement that works for me is:

import pandas as pd # placed at the front of the file, and quite slow, unfortunately

if isinstance(mu_input, pd.core.series.Series): # check if pandas series
        mu_input = np.array(mu_input.values) # extract values and convert to numpy array

placed directly before line 80 in pre_edge.py

Of course it would be best to simply only pass numpy arrays, but this addition could be very useful for minimizing the debugging others might have to do. 

Thanks!
